decisions.reason: The resin injection unit was launched only a year ago and fits the firm's injection and plural-component core, so there is no clear shortfall against aspiration that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.
This second injection unit overlaps somewhat with Product A, but it is too early to judge its results and slack in a stable medium-sized firm allows it to be carried.
Automatic airless guns are a core accessory that supports pump sales, so the product likely meets aspirations as part of the established line.
Manual airless guns are a staple spare-part and accessory item with steady demand, and nothing reported suggests a shortfall.
The multi-model air-assisted line serves established industrial finishing customers and is too new to show a performance gap.
The data logger's results are the most uncertain because it moves into digital monitoring, but it matches the firm's innovation direction and slack allows it time to prove itself.
